gate_1_return_path.claim: the coupled step (the flow's one elimination over its openings and its point bodies) is the monolithic step (one dense LU of the whole step) within the field's solve's line, both dtypes

prediction.unit: relative (field, force, twist, pressure, flux), float64; float32 [1e-7, 2e-3]
prediction.basis: measured-before (smoke) and derived: the CG's tolerance carried through a well-conditioned small system
prediction.why: every unknown is a linear function of the unit fields' solves, each stopped at the CG's tolerance; the elimination's LU adds rounding only

gate_1_return_path.metric: the largest relative difference over the field and every partner's unknowns

control.plant: drop: the last partner dropped from the elimination (its deliveries held at zero); cross: every partner's rows read only its own deliveries (the cross terms zeroed)
control.resolution: a planted partner's force or a cross term is of the order of the body's drag, many orders above the line in both dtypes [derived]; not measured with discriminating_range.py, the plants being structural (on or off)

gate_1_return_path.if_wrong: a miss on the clean arm is the elimination's (or the reference's) defect: compare the unit fields' readings with the reference's Jacobian columns
gate_1_return_path.cannot_discriminate_if: a draw whose partners do not interact (no cross term): every draw has two partners sharing one field

gate_2_ledger_one_pass.claim: metered, one pass: every receiver's books close at every step, the drag's two rows judged by its node (no gift), and their sum is minus the law's own dissipation: the exchange is workless, with no lagged residual

prediction.unit: relative to the law's dissipation, float64; float32 [0, 1e-3]
prediction.basis: derived: the flow's row is dt <S_F f, u'> = dt f . G_F u' by the transpose pair, the body's -dt f . V' at the twist the row closed
prediction.why: the body's twist is the row's to its own 6 x 6 solve's rounding; the float32 band allows the handed load's cancellation (A0 - R_h V', the body near the fluid's speed)

control.plant: handed: a hundredth of the handed load's size added to it
control.resolution: derived: the plant's work against the body's motion is of the order of the drag's work, far above the line

gate_2_ledger_one_pass.if_wrong: a clean miss means the body did not step with the row the flow closed (gate 4) or the books read another force than the one solved
gate_2_ledger_one_pass.cannot_discriminate_if: a body at rest with the fluid (no slip, no dissipation): the drawn body is twice as dense as the water and slips

gate_3_gradient_one_pass.claim: one pass, the body's axial position after 10 steps differentiated in the viscosity (forward) equals a central difference to 1e-5

prediction.basis: measured-before: the lagged route's gate 9 passes at this operating point; the elimination is linear algebra JAX differentiates
prediction.why: custom_linear_solve and the dense LU have exact derivatives

gate_3_gradient_one_pass.metric: relative difference of the derivative from the central difference

control.plant: held: the elimination's solution held out of the derivative (stop_gradient)
control.resolution: guess: the elimination carries the drag's dependence on the viscosity, a share of order one of the derivative

gate_3_gradient_one_pass.if_wrong: a clean miss: compare forward and reverse, then the unit fields' derivative alone
gate_3_gradient_one_pass.cannot_discriminate_if: the drag's force independent of the viscosity at this point (it is not: R0 is 6 pi mu a)

gate_4_mirror.claim: one pass, the body steps with the row the flow closed: every other load and resistance delivered into it reaches the flow's row the same step, so row_mismatch_flagged is never raised over the run

prediction.unit: the worst relative mismatch in float64; float32 [0, 1e-4], under the flag's line 1e4 eps
prediction.basis: derived: the body's own solve with the handed response reproduces the row's twist to its rounding
prediction.why: the handed response and load are the elimination's own, and the mirror makes the row's loads the body's

control.plant: mirror: the build's held rows dropped (the flow's row then lacks the rate terms' load and the added mass)
control.resolution: derived: the added mass alone is half the displaced fluid's mass over dt in the row, a share of order 0.2 of the stepping mass at density ratio 2

gate_4_mirror.if_wrong: a clean flag means a load reached the body that the flow's row did not hold: find its edge
gate_4_mirror.cannot_discriminate_if: a body with no other load: the Maxey-Riley part is always delivered on the stokes rung
